description: Source code for NEON-optimized IQ compression and decompression functions in the ocudu project, specifically for the 'none' compression method using NEON intrinsics.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Compresses IQ data into a buffer using NEON intrinsics if supported, otherwise falls back to a generic implementation.

methods.name: decompress
methods.description: Decompresses IQ data from a buffer using NEON intrinsics if supported, otherwise falls back to a generic implementation.
